name: atr_breakout_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when a 5-second candle's range exceeds 1.5× the recent 2-minute average true range, it signals that a large directional market order has swept multiple price levels within a single 5-second window — characteristic of institutional algo execution (TWAP/VWAP programs) that have initiated a directional leg. These programs typically fill only 30-60% of their intended size per burst, leaving continuation pressure that persists for the next 30-90 seconds. We enter at the close of the expansion candle in the direction of the bar (bullish close → CE, bearish close → PE), capturing the continuation leg before the program order is complete.
core_signal_oneliner: Single 5-second bar range exceeds 1.5x the 2-minute ATR with above-average volume, signaling institutional program order initiation
